QuestInfo.name: Sabotage
QuestInfo.0: It's time to take the fight to the aliens. Sabotage their mining operations.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9201050##k gave you four sabo-missions to sabotage the alien mining operations. \n\nLight up a Gunpowder Mound, destroy the Galacto-Drill, steal the research samples, and break their computer.
QuestInfo.2: The aliens are in disarray! However, there are a lot of townspeople trapped near their base...
